features.title: Everything to move a load, in one place
features.subtitle: From posting to delivery — ReLod handles matching, outreach, and tracking so you don't have to juggle five apps.
features.matchingDesc: Post a load and get an automatically ranked shortlist of nearby carriers — by distance, truck type, capacity and availability. No manual searching.
features.trackingDesc: Every trip tracked from pickup to delivery — through the carrier's GPS device if they have one, or their phone if they don't. Same experience either way.
features.whatsappDesc: Select carriers from your shortlist and message them all on WhatsApp with one tap — no switching apps, no typing the same message twice.
features.bookingDesc: Track every booking from acceptance to delivery, and get matched to return-trip loads along your usual route.
features.documentsDesc: RC, insurance, permits, fitness and driver documents — uploaded once, attached to your vehicle, ready when a shipper asks.
features.languageDesc: Switch the entire app between English and Hindi any time — built for how India's transporters actually work.

about.title: About ReLod
about.metaDescription: ReLod is a direct marketplace connecting Indian shippers and truck owners, with ranked carrier matching, WhatsApp outreach and live GPS tracking.
about.heroTitle: Built to remove friction. Built for shippers and truck owners, equally.
about.heroBody: ReLod is India's direct load-truck marketplace. We connect shippers with truck owners directly — cutting out the layers that add delay and cost, so both sides get a fairer deal.
about.missionBody: A two-sided load board where shippers and truck owners deal directly: ranked matches based on distance, truck type, capacity and availability; one-tap WhatsApp outreach so no one has to re-type the same message to ten different contacts; and live tracking that works whether or not a truck has a GPS device installed.
about.whoBody: Shippers who need a truck for a load, and truck owners — from single-vehicle owner-operators to small fleets — who need loads for their trucks. Built bilingual in English and Hindi from day one.
about.todayBody: ReLod is an early-stage platform. We're building deliberately — verified onboarding, compliant payment settlement and GST invoicing are being built the right way rather than rushed, because freight and payments both need to be trustworthy.

diagram.oldWaySubtitle: Many steps. More delays. Higher costs.
diagram.newWaySubtitle: Fewer steps. More clarity. Better outcomes.
diagram.footnote: Shippers and truck owners can each post — whichever side starts, the match happens on ReLod.

faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.metaDescription: Answers to common questions about how ReLod's load matching, WhatsApp outreach, tracking and registration work.
faq.q1Body: When a shipper posts a load, ReLod searches for carriers within 100 km first, automatically expanding to 200 km if none are found. Carriers are ranked by distance, truck type and capacity match, availability, and rating.
faq.q2Title: How do I contact matched carriers?
faq.q2Body: ReLod shows you a ranked, pre-selected list of matching carriers. You can remove anyone you don't want to contact, then send a WhatsApp message to everyone left on the list with one tap.
faq.q3Body: If a truck has a GPS device installed, it's tracked automatically. If it doesn't, the carrier can share their live location from their phone during the trip. Either way, the shipper sees the same live tracking view.
faq.q4Body: Yes. Both shipper and carrier registration are free — you'll verify your phone number and WhatsApp number with an OTP, then fill in your business or vehicle details.
faq.q5Body: Today these are self-declared during registration. We're working on connecting them to real verification — this page will be updated once that's live.
faq.q6Body: ReLod currently runs in your phone's browser — no separate app install needed. Tracking and messaging both work from there.
faq.stillBody: We're here to help. Reach out to our team anytime.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.metaDescription: ReLod's terms of service (draft, pending legal review).
terms.s1Body: These terms will govern use of the ReLod platform by shippers, truck owners and other users, once finalised.
terms.s2Body: ReLod is a marketplace connecting shippers and truck owners. ReLod facilitates introductions, matching, communication and tracking between the two parties.
terms.s3Body: Terms covering how a booking is formed, and the conditions under which either party may cancel, will be set out here.
terms.s4Body: How payments between shippers and carriers are handled, including any platform fees, will be described here once the payment settlement mechanism is finalised.
terms.s5Body: Expectations around accurate load/vehicle information, valid documents, and lawful use of the platform will be set out here.
terms.s6Body: The scope of ReLod's liability as an intermediary platform, as distinct from the shipper's and carrier's own obligations to each other, will be defined here.
terms.s7Body: Questions about these terms can be sent to the contact address on our Contact page.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.metaDescription: ReLod's privacy policy (draft, pending legal review).
privacy.s1Body: Registration details (name, phone, WhatsApp number, business or vehicle information), location data during active tracking, and documents you upload.
privacy.s2Body: To operate load matching, enable communication between shippers and carriers, provide live tracking during a trip, and verify accounts.
privacy.s3Body: Live location is only shared during an active, in-transit booking, and only with the shipper for that specific booking.
privacy.s4Body: We do not sell personal data. Details of any third-party processors (payment, messaging, verification providers) will be listed here once finalised.
privacy.s5Body: How you can access, correct or request deletion of your data will be described here, in line with applicable Indian data protection law.
privacy.s6Body: Questions about this policy can be sent to the contact address on our Contact page.
